input.body:
label: question
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The error "Malformed row: the number of columns does not match the header" is triggered in the parseStatement function in src/ingest/parser.ts. It happens when the number of fields in a row does not match the number of columns in the header, or if a required column is missing.

The function expects columns named exactly "date", "amount", and "description" (case-insensitive) and throws this error if these are not all found in the header or if any data row has a mismatched number of columns. Since your finance export tool on Windows is new, it may be producing a CSV with a slightly different format, e.g., with missing or extra columns, or some issue with commas or quoting that affects parsing.

You might want to check if the CSV files have any BOM character, extra columns, or different delimiters. Also ensure the header line exactly contains "date", "amount", and "description" as columns (ignoring case) and that each row has the exact same number of fields as the header line.
